title: Joint time-evolution orbits of the periodic binary box-ball system with every amplitude one through N present and positive vacancy numbers are finite integer tori with explicit internal-symmetry period matrices and translation velocities
author: Taichiro Takagi
work: Level Set Structure of an Integrable Cellular Automaton
source_version: Official SIGMA 6 (2010) article 027, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2010.027; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: Knowing the inverse scattering bijection does not identify joint evolution orbits when solitons of equal amplitude have internal periods. The author stratifies extended riggings by exact cyclic stabilizers, constructs commuting twisted slide and translation actions, and proves that the internal-stabilizer action is a rigging-independent period lattice. He transports the quotient back through the scattering map and matches every time evolution with its explicit integer velocity.

proof_review.note: Read full actual binary pBBS/KKR/extended-rigging setup9-13, exact internal-period/stabilizer strata5-8 and their twisted slide action(8)-(10), concrete orbit quotient proof3-4, normalization/scattering transport12-14 and transitivity/velocity calculation14, plus full elementary permutation/descent Lemmas7-8 on16-17. Select the concrete Theorem2 joint orbit for m_j>0 for j=1,...,N, N>=2 and strict positive vacancies p_j=L-2sum_k min(j,k)m_k>0. The exact state stratum determines alpha_j dividing both m_j,p_j; F_alpha entries are (delta_jk p_k+2min(j,k)m_k)/alpha_k. The source proves that the slide stabilizer acts by this constant integer matrix, independent of normalized riggings, and the physical time-evolution group acts by all Z^N translations (the min matrix has determinant1). This is the specific full-translation model, not a count of the generic abstract group theorem. Prior Kuniba-Takagi-Takenouchi2006 Theorem3.12 is the exact established inverse-scattering bijection, stated as Proposition6 physical13; no higher-type conjecture from013 is used. The torus is the finite quotient F_alpha Z^N backslash Z^N, not a continuous manifold. Sparse amplitude variants, vacancy-zero edge case, period/count corollaries and the generic orbit lemma are uncounted. No independent reproof or reconstructed dynamics. Exact selected statement and terminal proof pages rendered and visually inspected; physical headers/native ZIP members and source/license hashes checked. No independent mathematical reproof.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Concrete Theorem2 for periodic binary words of length L and soliton counts m_j>0 at every amplitude j=1,...,N, N>=2, with p_j=L-2sum_k min(j,k)m_k>0. For a state in the exact alpha internal-rigging symmetry stratum, its joint orbit under the authored commuting evolution group T is equivariantly bijective to the finite integer quotient F_alpha Z^N backslash Z^N, where F_alpha[j,k]=(delta_jk p_k+2min(j,k)m_k)/alpha_k; T_l acts by h_l[j]=min(j,l). No continuous-topological torus assertion, sparse-amplitude extension or zero-vacancy branch.
